title: WPMS/2603/2018 of Sashi Kumar Sharma Vs Assistant Collector First Class / Sub Divisional Magistrate Rishikesh District Derhadun AND OTHERS

paras.text:
MCC No. 106 of 2019
In
WPMS No. 2603 of 2018
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Kishore Kumar, Advocate on
behalf of Mr. D.S. Mehta, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. V.D. Bisen, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Amendment Application No. 106 of
2019 is allowed.
Necessary amendment is directed to be
carried out within a week.
After the amendment is being carried
out in the cause title of the writ petition, the
order would also be accordingly amended.
